# Citation Machine

> > Citation Machine is a comprehensive citation generator and academic writing assistant supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard formats with integrated plagiarism detection and grammar checking.

Citation Machine provides automated citation formatting tools and writing assistance features for students and academics. The platform supports multiple citation styles and includes plagiarism detection, grammar checking, and detailed citation guides for various source types.

## Key Topics

- APA citation format
- MLA citation format
- Chicago style
- Citation generation
- Plagiarism checker
- Grammar checker
- Book citations
- Journal citations
- DOI (Digital Object Identifier)
- ISBN (International Standard Book Number)
- Academic writing
- Reference formatting
- Citation Machine Plus
- Paper editing
- Writing assistance

## Core Citation Tools

- [Citation Machine: Format & Generate - APA, MLA, & Chicago](https://www.citationmachine.net): Homepage and main citation generator supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard citation formats
- [Paper Checker: Instant plagiarism checker tool | Citation Machine](https://www.citationmachine.net/grammar-and-plagiarism): Plagiarism and grammar checker tool integrated within Citation Machine Plus for detecting academic integrity issues

## Citation Guides & Resources

- [Citation Machine - Resources and Guides](https://www.citationmachine.net/resources): Comprehensive citation guides and resources for APA, MLA, Chicago and other citation styles

## APA Citation Guides

- [Citing a Book in APA | Citation Machine](https://www.citationmachine.net/apa/cite-a-book): APA guide for citing books with ISBN information and proper reference formatting
- [Citing a Journal in APA | Citation Machine](https://www.citationmachine.net/apa/cite-a-journal): APA guide for citing academic journals with DOI references and in-text citations

## MLA Citation Guides

- [Free Citing a Book in MLA | Citation Machine](https://www.citationmachine.net/mla/cite-a-book): MLA guide for citing books with ISBN information and proper works cited formatting
- [Free Citing a Journal in MLA | Citation Machine](https://www.citationmachine.net/mla/cite-a-journal): MLA guide for citing journals with DOI references and in-text citation methods
